Solara — (9.2) NEBULA

ECLIPSE OF ORDER

"Eclipse of order"

[Intro — sparse, cold, a single note held long]

[Verse 1]

He liked things in their correct place

Everything has a correct place

Even destruction

Especially destruction

He liked knowing what was coming

Before it arrived

What it would do before it did it

What it would cost before the bill

You cannot eclipse order

If you do not know

Exactly

Where order stands

[Pre-Chorus]

Historia said: there is a crew in the fold

Moving through the levels

Disorder said: which crew

She said: the one with the light

He said: I know which one — how many

She said: eight

He said: (quietly)(very quietly) fine

[Chorus]

Eclipse of order

Not the end of the system

The moment before the end

When the light bends

And what was certain becomes a question

Eclipse of order

Disorder does not break things

Disorder understands things

Precisely — perfectly

And then decides exactly where to press

[Verse 2]

Historia had a gift

She knew things the way old stone knows weather

She said: there is someone in that crew who should not be there

He carries knowledge that does not belong to the living

The kind that takes three hundred thousand years to accumulate

He has it — all of it

And he is not old enough to have earned it

(how)(that is the question)

(who gave it to him)(that is a better question)

[Pre-Chorus 2]

And then a message arrived from the other direction

Chaos has a crew

(how many)(five)

Havoc (yes) Ruin (yes) Mayhem (yes)

Disorder set the message down

He straightened it on the table — precisely

He aligned the corners

(are you alright)(I am fine)

(you are aligning the corners)(I am always fine)

(you have aligned them four times)(Historia)(yes)(I am fine)

[Bridge — Historia speaks carefully]

She said: I have searched every record

Every account of how knowledge moves through the cosmos

He said: and

She said: there is only one name

That appears in the margin of every account

Where something impossible happened anyway

He said: what name

She said: Initium Finis

(the room went still)

She said: I think he is the reason

That man is alive

And carrying everything he carries

(silence)(very long silence)

(Disorder straightened the message again)

[Final Chorus]

Eclipse of order

Initium Finis — the one who only watches — watched

And then did something

And now there is a dead man walking through the fold

With three hundred thousand years of knowledge in his hands

Eclipse of order

If Initium Finis moved after three hundred thousand years of only watching

Then something is happening that has not happened before

And Disorder intends to know what it is

Before the light does

[Outro]

He stood

He said: send word to Chaos

Historia said: what word

He said: tell him to try not to break everything before I get there

(she wrote it down)(exactly as he said it)(for once)(the notes were perfect)
